review: Keep rivet-deck and metal-wedge colour grain at full resolution and fine highlights on narrow metal surfaces. Give the Crown ship sails and repeated boardwalk twice the default data-map resolution after close-up review. Colour encodes that fail their error gates retain approved full-resolution versions. Carlisle harbour colour maps are normally at most 1024 after the November 2026 GPU-memory review; the fish market and repair shed are owned by the top-40 stage. The shrimp boat keeps a 2048 colour map: at 1024 its hull paint detail smeared in a 7 m close-up (docs/carlisle-textures-1024).

resizedColor.review: Resized colour maps are compared against their sharpened resized reference, which is far noisier than an original. The resize is the authorized loss; the lossy encode on top uses the highest WebP quality and only this sanity floor. Judge them by paired captures.
